kids.t: Community-trained ranger-guide focused on primate behaviour and low-impact trekking groups.
General touring guide comfortable leading multi-day itineraries across several parks.
Kibale-based forest guide specializing in birding walks alongside chimp trekking.
Licensed safari guide since 2017, specializing in big-game tracking and birding across Uganda's western parks.
Grew up on the lake shore — leads canoe trips and knows every island's history first-hand.
Second-generation safari driver-guide covering the western circuit, known for calm, patient game drives.
